question: A bone marrow transplant patient develops fever and right upper lobe pulmonary infiltrates 2 weeks post-transplant. The hospital is undergoing renovation adjacent to the transplant unit. Which environmental surveillance method is most relevant to investigate the likely source?

answers.text: Air sampling for fungal spores using settle plates or active impaction sampling

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Construction and renovation near immunocompromised wards is a well-recognised risk factor for invasive pulmonary aspergillosis. Disturbed dust releases Aspergillus fumigatus spores into hospital air. Air sampling (settle plates or active Anderson/RCS impaction samplers) quantifies the airborne fungal spore burden.

answers.text: Water culture for Legionella from cooling towers

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Legionella surveillance targets water distribution systems (cooling towers, hot water systems) for Legionnaires' disease. The clinical picture here — pulmonary infiltrates in an immunocompromised patient with nearby construction — points to airborne fungal exposure, not waterborne Legionella.

answers.text: Surface swabs from bedside rails and equipment

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Surface swabs detect contact-transmitted organisms (MRSA, VRE, C. difficile) on high-touch surfaces. The scenario describes construction-related airborne exposure in an immunocompromised patient — air sampling for fungal spores is the targeted investigation.

Stool cultures screen food handlers for enteric pathogens (Salmonella, Shigella). The clinical picture — pulmonary infiltrates in a transplant patient with adjacent construction — indicates airborne fungal exposure, not a food-borne infection.

overallFeedback.feedback: Construction and renovation near transplant units release Aspergillus fumigatus spores. Air sampling (settle plates or active impaction with Anderson/RCS samplers) quantifies airborne fungal spore burden and identifies the source of the outbreak.

Construction dust releases Aspergillus spores, threatening immunocompromised patients. Air sampling is the targeted surveillance method; HEPA-filtered positive-pressure rooms and sealed ventilation are the preventive measures during renovation.
